processes.meter_flow_missing_deal_resolution: Logistics/volume management flags a meter with flow but an expired or missing deal ticket and asks the desk to extend the deal, create a new one, or write off the volume.
processes.deal_ticket_creation_request: Traders or originators ask logistics to create or look up a Sitara deal ticket for new or changed supply, and logistics confirms the ticket number.
processes.deal_price_discrepancy_resolution: Settlements or counterparties report a price or volume mismatch between an invoice and the deal ticket and ask the desk to confirm and correct it.
processes.nomination_change_handling: Revised or first-of-month nominations from counterparties are relayed to the desk, confirmed with pipelines, and updated in Unify/Sitara.
processes.meter_volume_feed_correction: Zero or missing meter volumes in POPS/MIPS feeds are detected, overridden with estimates, and re-allocated so Sitara and P&L stay accurate.
processes.intercompany_accrual_variance_review: Settlements lists accrual volume variances or missing sides on intercompany deals and asks the desk to explain and fix them.
processes.pipeline_shut_in_notice: Field operations notify the desk of leaks and meter shut-ins and their repair status so schedulers can adjust.
